_format: rooms: room id -> ambience sound id, combat track id (or null), `cues` (script cue name -> track id: the stage script sends these, src/sim/sequencer.ts `music`) and `diegetic` (the track a boombox in the room plays). tracks: id -> bpm, beatsPerBar, loopStart/loopEnd (s; 0/0 = loop the whole file) and stems (files in assets/music/, named s{stage}_{cue}_{stem}.wav as in design/audio-direction.md; combat cues: intensity layers 1-3). A track whose files aren't all in assets/music/ yet is skipped: its room plays the ambience only, and a boombox plays radio static.
